BiblicalUsage: Kav is the Aramaic word for a window. Daniel 6:10 says Daniel went into his house, and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Daniel's open window is the picture of prayer that will not hide, even when the law says to shut it.
